title: Denmark to expel Russian diplomat over alleged plot to kill US-Ukrainian rapper
summary_full: Moscow intelligence thought to be behind plan to kill musician Kyivstoner before concert in DenmarkDenmark’s foreign minister has said Russia’s defence attache in Copenhagen would be expelled after Moscow was suspected of being behind an attempted killing of a US-Ukrainian rapper.“We have just summoned the Russian ambassador to the ministry of foreign affairs and notified him of the government’s decision to expel the Russian defence attache from Denmark,” Lars Løkke Rasmussen told a news conference. The expulsion will happen within seven days. Continue reading...
